atoms.a: When Rosa Parks was arrested in December 1955, African Americans stood up against racial segregation. One of them was Martin Luther King Jr. He was the leader of an organisation called MIA.

atoms.b: Martin Luther King Jr. was a famous civil rights leader in the United States. He ((was_born)) on ((January_15,_1929)) in Atlanta, Georgia.

King was a Baptist minister and believed in non-violent protest. He wanted to ((end_racism_and_segregation)) in America. He became the leader of the Montgomery Bus Boycott in ((1955)), after Rosa Parks refused to give up her seat on a bus.

atoms.b: In ((1963)), he gave his most famous ((speech)): “I have a dream”. In the speech, he spoke about a world where all people are equal, no matter the ((colour)) of their skin.
In 1964, Martin Luther King Jr. received the ((Nobel_Peace_Prize)) for his peaceful fight for justice. He continued to fight ((for_civil_rights)) and helped to change laws in the USA.

On April 4, 1968, he was killed in Memphis, Tennessee. Today, people remember him as a ((hero)). In the USA, Martin Luther King Day is a national ((holiday)), celebrated every third Monday in January.
